result:
I've planned round 493 as a docs-only re-dispatch of the same three Medium bugs, and set the decision to **CONTINUE**. I touched only planning files; the store tree is unchanged, and it still holds round 492's v3 sketch as A left it.

**Why round 492 failed:** A stopped, correctly, on one false sentence in doc 318 (line 22). It said the Current Password field shows a focus ring when the dialog opens, but after a mouse open the ring is hidden by the site-wide SABA-B-4 rule. C logged this as C-R492-01 (Low, a mistake in my spec). C's browser check passed on v3 (54 rows) and `browserVerified` is true, but the verdict is FAIL. So nothing is marked done or მზადაა, and gate 492 was skipped; the baseline stays `e4e1d1c`.

**What round 493 changes (docs only, called v5):**
- **Doc 318:**
  - line 22 describes the ring by input type: shown after a keyboard open and after Esc, hidden after a mouse open, Cancel or backdrop click;
  - the status line becomes `C round 493 PASS`;
  - the private probe name "R7" becomes browser rows P11 and P12;
  - the PD8 test line now claims only the assert that can actually fail.
- **Docs 315 and 317:** "round 492" becomes "round 493".
- **Three more sentences fixed after `tech-lead` rejected my first draft (v4).** I re-ran the evidence for each myself, and v5 was approved:
  - The "0 px" pixel match only holds at the probe's 16/255 tolerance; without it, 823–1158 px differ by at most 8/255.
  - The doc said one Esc closing both Ctrl+K and the dialog was also HEAD behaviour. That is false: at HEAD, Esc closes only the palette. Closing both is new.
  - "Reopening during the fade keeps the typed values" is untested, so it is now worded as an inference.
- **Code and tests:** byte-equal to v3. The v5 production build is byte-identical to v3, and the six covering test files pass (97 tests).

**How A applies it:** the expected case is the docs delta on top of the v3 tree. If the tree turns out clean at `e4e1d1c`, A applies the full v5 patch instead; that case has its own saved start-check output. Any other start state is a stop.

**What C checks:** the full table, C1–C10, not the short route. For `/studio-lab` play/stop, C reads the hidden `[data-testid="arrangement-playback-state"]` span. C's text search missed it last round; my probe shows Stopped → Playing → Stopped at both viewports.

**Rulings and backlog:**
- A's nine new Low review findings and one info finding go to `deferred_low_polish`. The task lists them as already ruled, so they cannot stop A.
- Two of them A flagged for me:
  - The Esc check ignores `keyCode 229`. LeadMagnet has the same gap, so they will be fixed together.
  - One assert in test PD8 can never fail. The doc now claims only the one that can.
- C-R492-01 is recorded and closes with round 493's pass.
- A's architecture note ("keep the code where it is") is recorded on the existing account-profile signal.
- I added a RETRO 495 candidate: three code reviews passed a false doc sentence, so the sketch review should check every doc sentence against the saved browser rows.
- B-R492-PASSWORD-CHANGE-NOT-IMPLEMENTED (High) stays with root. Changing a password still always fails, because the protected `auth.ts` throws, and that blocks the final COMPLETE.

**Next:** if round 493 passes, DPG-BUTTON-CLEANUP. RETRO is at round 495; no regression round is due until 2026-11-16. Nothing is ready to commit, since round 492 was not published.

The advisor was available and I consulted it twice. `tech-lead` was consulted twice (v4 rejected, v5 approved).
